description: List the captured snapshots of a URL in the Internet Archive Wayback Machine over time, using the CDX index. Each entry includes the capture timestamp, the original URL, HTTP status code, MIME type, content digest and a direct Wayback snapshot URL. Optionally restrict to a date range with from/to (YYYYMMDD).

from.description: Optional start of date range as YYYYMMDD.

limit.description: Maximum number of snapshots to return (default 50, max 1000).

to.description: Optional end of date range as YYYYMMDD.

url.description: The page URL to list archived snapshots for, e.g. "example.com".

name: list_snapshots
title: List Snapshots
